function.description: Preview a Relay bridge to/from Robinhood Chain (4663) — routes, fees, ETA, USD estimates. Relay is the direct bridge for Robinhood Chain (Khalani does not cover it). Resolve token addresses first. `amountRaw` is in smallest units (wei). Read-only.
function.name: relay__quote__get

amountRaw.description: Amount to bridge, in raw atomic units of fromToken (e.g. USDC has 6 decimals, so 1 USDC = "1000000"). Raw base units as an integer string (not human decimals) — read the token's decimals from `token_find` first.

fromChain.description: Source chain id or alias (e.g. base, 8453, robinhood, 4663).

fromToken.description: Source token address, or native ETH/native.

slippageBps.description: Basis points (1 bps = 0.01%). Default 100 = 1%. Vex caps this at 1000 (10%) and REJECTS a higher value rather than clamping it.

toToken.description: Destination token address, or native ETH/native.
